answer: Because the custody account is separate, an adversary cannot recycle one pool of capital across 198 aliases, and each one needs its own funded horizon account. Deposits are visible in juniper, and zephyr reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 22% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. The attacker spends 76 dollars and 12 days per identity before it can vote at all. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
